doc: THE STD GUARD, active: slope 20 gives a pre-normalization std of 2.0e-14, BELOW 1e-12, so the division is by the guard, not by the std: the output is (field - mean) / 1e-12 and its std is 0.020, not 1. This is the case that pins the guard VALUE from below: the slope 10 and 14 cases bound it from above (it must stay under 1.8e-10), this one fixes it (the output scales as 1/guard: a guard of 1e-15 gives std 1 here, 1e-9 gives 2e-5). Never reached by the generator. The white noise the seed draws is the input plan0.white (size, size). FFT convention: numpy fft2 unnormalized forward, ifft2 divides by size^2, k = fftfreq(size) * size. Measured: max |diff| 2.8e-17 on values up to 0.075 (1.5e-14 relative above 1e-3; scipy.fft 2.1e-17), so 1e-9 relative / 1e-12 absolute: the guard is pinned to better than 1e-9 relative.
